title: Add end-to-end regression fixtures
objective: Deterministic backend/frontend fixtures for the reported calendar scenario — Cooking, Foods Dinner, DCP Bark Bar trivia, Steelers vs Packers, excluded/quarantined classification, assigned rows, over-assignment with only 2 available blocks versus 16 included blocks — pinning chronological order, hard wall safety, explicit infeasibility, fixed/excluded accounting, and zero calendar writer calls.

backend.fake_store: read-only EventStore fake recording a call ledger; writer methods deliberately absent so any write path raises

regression_contracts.FEEDBACK-01_chronological: final merged sequence sorted by start (Log hours 17:15 precedes pinned 23:15 row); validate rejects descending order deterministically; merge_immutable_rows sorts by (start, id)
regression_contracts.FEEDBACK-02_hard_walls: Cooking (fixed) and DCP Bark Bar trivia (work) are non-permeable walls — assigned overlap hard-rejects; Foods Dinner window stays permeable (soft advisory); config-backed blocks stay acceptable-defect
regression_contracts.FEEDBACK-03_explicit_infeasibility: 16 included blocks vs 2 available: dropped rows surface as '⚠ overflow infeasible' warnings naming the row and capacity; never staged over a wall; never-bump names a missing row loudly
regression_contracts.FEEDBACK-04_classification: Cooking->fixed, DCP Bark Bar trivia->work, Steelers vs Packers->quarantined per EXPLICIT config rules; quarantined rows cost zero capacity, wall nothing, and stay out of fixed-input fingerprints (contract 17)
regression_contracts.FEEDBACK-05_zero_writer_calls: backend fake store ledger records only auth_status/calendars/query_events; frontend spies assert liveCommit/shadowCommit/runtimeAction/undoRuntimeAction never called during load -> setup -> sequence

safety_proof.live_post_sequence_adjust_commit: none — backend tests use a read-only fake EventStore and pure unit calls; frontend tests use FixtureAdapter + vitest mocks, never a live endpoint
safety_proof.external_writes: none — calendar writers are absent on the fake store and spied-and-asserted-absent on the frontend adapter
safety_proof.branch_or_index_mutation: none — no commit, stage, reset, clean, stash, rebase, or merge
safety_proof.foreign_changes_preserved: tracked dirty work (.gitignore, AGENTS.md, README.md, gem-team.yaml, .opencode, docs/plan extraction plan.yaml) untouched; edited files live in untracked app/ and frontend/ dirs, same as FEEDBACK-01..04

out_of_scope_noted: UI polish (later_polish group): 24-hour formatting, calendar action controls, 'Not attending' wording
store.ts acceptableDefects unchanged — infeasibility warnings ride the existing SEQUENCE_OK warnings path (FEEDBACK-03)
fixtureValidate wall filter in frontend/src/adapters/fixture.ts still ignores capacityClass (dead dev-mock path, unchanged per FEEDBACK-04 out_of_scope)
